New Connection and Re-Verification KYC Procedure

Document ID: SOP_C17_KYC_VERIFICATION

Category: C17 — KYC & Identity Verification

Department: Compliance

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To ensure all new connections and periodic re-verifications meet regulatory KYC standards.

Procedure

Collect one Proof of Identity and one Proof of Address from the approved document list.

For Aadhaar-based e-KYC, obtain explicit customer consent before OTP-based verification.

For video-KYC, complete the liveness check, geo-tag capture, and document-to-face match.

Reject and request re-submission if any document is illegible, expired, or mismatched.

Store verification records per the data retention schedule in Policy_C19_privacy_policy.
